title: Contracting with an Agent under Model Mismatch
abstract: arXiv:2610.23402v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: In the classical principal-agent setting, the principal delegates some task to the agent, who receives a payment conditioned on the outcome of the task, which in turn benefits the principal. To align their objectives, the principal designs a contract that incentivizes the agent to take actions beneficial to the principal. In practice, however, the agent may act under misspecified beliefs about the underlying environment, leading to systematically suboptimal decisions. In this work, we study this problem through a principal-agent Markov Decision Process (PAMDP), in which the principal repeatedly interacts with an agent whose transition model may differ from the true environment dynamics. The principal has access to the true transition model and designs contracts that account for the agent's belief and incentives. translated_title: 模型失配下与代理人的合同设计
translated_abstract: 在经典的委托-代理设定中，委托人将某项任务委托给代理人，代理人根据任务结果获得报酬，而该结果又为委托人带来收益。为了使双方目标一致，委托人设计合同以激励代理人采取有利于委托人的行动。然而在实践中，代理人可能基于对底层环境的错误认知而采取行动，从而导致系统性的次优决策。在本研究中，我们通过一个委托-代理马尔可夫决策过程（PAMDP）来研究这一问题，其中委托人与一个转移模型可能与真实环境动态不一致的代理人进行反复交互。委托人掌握真实的转移模型，并设计能够兼顾代理人信念与激励的合同。我们刻画了模型失配情形下的合同设计，并开发了一个使委托人能够引导代理人产生理想长期行为的框架。
tldr: 该论文在委托-代理马尔可夫决策过程（PAMDP）中刻画了代理人因模型失配而持有错误信念时的合同设计问题，并提出了一个框架，使掌握真实环境动态的委托人能够通过合同设计引导代理人产生理想的长期行为。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes contract design under model mismatch in a principal-agent Markov Decision Process where the agent acts on misspecified beliefs, and develops a framework that enables the informed principal to induce desirable agent behavior through contracts.
